info.title: Carbone.io Universal API
info.description: Generate and convert documents from templates, manage template assets, and retrieve rendered outputs through the Carbone Cloud API.

post.description: Creates a converted document from uploaded templates in Carbone.io.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

batchOutput.description: Output format for batch processing, such as zip or pdf.

batchReportName.description: File name template for each item produced by batch rendering.

batchSplitBy.description: JSON path used to split an array into multiple generated reports.

complement.description: Additional JSON data exposed in the template as complement fields.

converter.description: Optional conversion engine override when Carbone exposes multiple converters.

convertTo.description: Target format name such as pdf, docx, xlsx, html, csv, png, or webp.

currencyRates.description: Custom currency rates object used for conversion.

currencySource.description: Source currency code used when Carbone performs currency conversion.

currencyTarget.description: Target currency code used when Carbone performs currency conversion.

data.description: JSON dataset merged into the template.

enum.description: Enumeration map available to Carbone enum conversion helpers.

hardRefresh.description: Recompute pagination and table of contents after rendering.

lang.description: Language code used for locale-aware formatting.

reportName.description: Output file name template for the generated report.

template.description: Base64-encoded contents of the source document to convert.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used when rendering date and time formatters.

translations.description: Localization dictionary used by translation tags in the template.

variableStr.description: Additional variable string passed to the render engine.

renderId.description: Render ID used to retrieve the converted document later.
